mapper.select: SELECT DATE(o.`paid_at`) AS `day`, SUM(o.`pay_amount_cents`) AS `revenueCents`, COUNT(*) AS `orderCount` FROM `orders` o WHERE o.`status` = 'COMPLETED' AND o.`paid_at` >= #{from} AND o.`paid_at` < #{to} GROUP BY DATE(o.`paid_at`) ORDER BY `day`

SELECT DATE(o.`paid_at`) AS `day`, COUNT(*) AS `totalOrderCount`, SUM(CASE WHEN o.`status` = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `validOrderCount` FROM `orders` o WHERE o.`paid_at` >= #{from} AND o.`paid_at` < #{to} GROUP BY DATE(o.`paid_at`) ORDER BY `day`
SELECT DATE(c.`created_at`) AS `day`, COUNT(*) AS `newUserCount` FROM `customer` c WHERE c.`created_at` >= #{from} AND c.`created_at` < #{to} GROUP BY DATE(c.`created_at`) ORDER BY `day`
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `customer` c WHERE c.`created_at` < #{until}
SELECT o.`status` AS `status`, COUNT(*) AS `total` FROM `orders` o GROUP BY o.`status`
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `orders` o WHERE o.`placed_at` >= #{from} AND o.`placed_at` < #{to}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `dish` d WHERE d.`status` = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `setmeal` s WHERE s.`status` = #{status}
